licensing_agencies.name: California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing Division (CCLD)
licensing_agencies.scope: Statewide licensing of child care centers and family child care homes

discovery.authoritative_registry: CCLD Care Facility Search (statewide download per facility category)
discovery.inspection_sources: Visit dates, citation codes, Type A/B totals and complaint outcomes in the statewide download; per-visit reports on the facility page
discovery.bulk_harvesting: One CSV per category; ArcGIS layer for coordinates
discovery.unavailable_fields: Website, hours, ages served (only via per-facility API comments), per-citation severity

sources.name: CCLD Care Facility Search — Child Care Centers statewide download
sources.publisher: California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing Division

coverage.program_classes: Licensed child care centers: day care (preschool), infant, single-license (infant + preschool), school-age and mildly-ill centers
coverage.excludes: Family child care homes (separate download, not indexed yet); closed centers before 2023

known_limitations: Citations are listed per center with their plan-of-correction dates, not per visit; each citation is matched to the latest visit on or before its correction due date.
Type A/B severity is published as totals per visit category, not per citation.
Visit report narratives (deficiency text) are on per-visit report pages and are not harvested yet.
The facility administrator is a person; it is never published here.

sources.name: CDSS Community Care Licensing Facilities (map layer)

coverage.program_classes: Child care program type (centers); coordinates only
coverage.excludes: Family child care homes are not in this layer

known_limitations: Used for coordinates only; licensing details come from the CCLD download.

sources.name: California Code of Regulations, Title 22 — section headings
sources.publisher: California Office of Administrative Law (via Cornell LII mirror)

coverage.program_classes: Headings for Title 22 sections cited at child care centers
coverage.excludes: Health and Safety Code sections (California statutes have no official section headings)

known_limitations: Only the section heading is used, to label citation codes.

sources.name: CCLD facility visit and complaint reports (LIC 809)
sources.publisher: California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing Division

coverage.program_classes: Per-visit reports with each deficiency, its Type A/B class and the section cited

known_limitations: About 76,000 report pages for open centers; planned, not harvested. Reports name licensing staff and facility staff, which would be removed.

harvest_status.reason: Harvest mode 'planned' is not a bulk harvest (research tool or planned).
